summary: Scans a 104-element dword array beginning at this+3974 (this+0x3E18) for a value equal to a2. Returns 1 when a matching element is found, 0 when the scan exhausts 104 elements without a match.

operations.description: v2 = 0; scan index initialized before the loop.
Iterate cursor i over dword array elements starting at this + 3974 (byte offset 0x3E18), comparing each element to a2.
If the incremented scan index reaches 104 without a match, return 0 (not found).
Return 1 when the current array element equals a2 (match found).

unresolved: Boolean result (1/0) does not expose the matching index; how the caller uses the found/not-found signal is unknown.
Semantic identity of the 104-element array at this+0x3E18 is unknown.
